_meta.data_status: SEED VALUES — directional only. Before publishing scores publicly, verify each carrier against: AM Best ratings (ambest.com), NAIC Complaint Index (naic.org consumer search), J.D. Power U.S. Auto Insurance Study & Property Claims Satisfaction Study (current year), and Consumer Reports carrier ratings.

claims_satisfaction.source: J.D. Power claims studies, Consumer Reports member surveys
claims_satisfaction.note: How carriers behave at the moment of truth. Weighted highest because this is what consumers actually buy.

complaint_index.source: NAIC Complaint Index (1.00 = average; lower is better)
complaint_index.note: Regulator-verified, normalized by market share. The most objective signal available.

value_pricing.note: Deliberately low weight — cheap coverage that fails at claim time is not value.

coverage_flexibility.source: Availability of RCV, umbrella, endorsements, accident forgiveness, new-car replacement

score_bands.90-100: Excellent — among the best in the industry
score_bands.80-89: Strong — reliable choice for most households
score_bands.70-79: Acceptable — fine coverage, watch for specific weaknesses
score_bands.60-69: Below average — meaningful complaint or claims concerns

carriers.name: USAA
carriers.strengths: Consistently top-rated claims satisfaction, low complaints, excellent financial strength
carriers.weaknesses: Eligibility restricted to military community
carriers.verdict: If you qualify, this is the benchmark every other carrier is measured against.

carriers.name: Amica
carriers.strengths: Decades of top-tier claims satisfaction, dividend policies available, very low complaint ratio
carriers.weaknesses: Premiums often above average
carriers.verdict: A pay-more-get-more carrier. Rarely the cheapest, almost never a regret at claim time.

carriers.name: Erie Insurance
carriers.strengths: Outstanding claims satisfaction, rate lock features, strong agent service
carriers.weaknesses: Limited geographic footprint
carriers.verdict: If Erie writes in your state, it belongs on your shortlist.

carriers.name: Auto-Owners
carriers.strengths: Top-tier financial strength, strong claims handling, competitive bundling
carriers.weaknesses: Agent-only distribution, no online quoting
carriers.verdict: Quietly excellent. Underrated because they don't advertise.

carriers.name: State Farm
carriers.strengths: Largest P&C insurer, huge agent network, strong financials, good bundling
carriers.weaknesses: Claims satisfaction varies by region; homeowner rate actions in catastrophe-prone states
carriers.verdict: The dependable default. Rarely the best or worst at anything.

carriers.name: Travelers
carriers.strengths: Strong financials, broad endorsement options, good for bundling with umbrella
carriers.weaknesses: Middling claims satisfaction scores
carriers.verdict: Solid, flexible coverage design. Ask about their umbrella pricing — often competitive.

carriers.name: Nationwide
carriers.strengths: Good coverage options, On Your Side review process, decent bundling
carriers.weaknesses: Has exited some personal-lines markets; pricing inconsistent
carriers.verdict: Reasonable choice; verify they're committed to your state before switching in.

carriers.name: American Family
carriers.strengths: Strong Midwest presence, diminishing deductible programs
carriers.weaknesses: Regional footprint, average claims scores
carriers.verdict: Competitive in its home territory, especially for bundlers.

carriers.name: Chubb
carriers.strengths: Best-in-class for high-value homes, cash-settlement options, exceptional claims service
carriers.weaknesses: Premium pricing; overkill for typical homes
carriers.verdict: If your home is worth $750k+ or has unique features, Chubb is worth every dollar.

carriers.name: GEICO
carriers.strengths: Competitive pricing, strong financials (Berkshire), easy digital experience
carriers.weaknesses: Claims satisfaction below top tier; homeowners is brokered to partners, not underwritten
carriers.verdict: Good price-driven choice for clean drivers; know that service is self-serve.

carriers.name: Progressive
carriers.strengths: Competitive rates especially for higher-risk drivers, Snapshot telematics, robust comparison tools
carriers.weaknesses: Below-average claims satisfaction; home policies often through partner underwriters
carriers.verdict: Strong on price, average at claim time. Check who actually underwrites the home policy.

carriers.name: Allstate
carriers.strengths: Large agent network, broad product line, Drivewise telematics
carriers.weaknesses: Persistent below-average claims satisfaction scores; aggressive rate increases in many states
carriers.verdict: Review competitiveness at every renewal — loyalty here often goes unrewarded.

carriers.name: Farmers
carriers.strengths: Wide endorsement menu, agent network
carriers.weaknesses: Higher complaint ratios, weaker financial rating than peers, market exits
carriers.verdict: If you're here, get comparison quotes at renewal. Better options usually exist at the same price.

carriers.name: Liberty Mutual
carriers.strengths: Broad availability, lots of coverage add-ons
carriers.weaknesses: Consistently low claims satisfaction rankings, high complaint volume
carriers.verdict: One of the most common 'switched and saved' origins we see. Compare carefully.

carriers.name: Safeco (Liberty Mutual)
carriers.strengths: Independent-agent flexibility, decent bundling
carriers.weaknesses: Shares Liberty Mutual claims infrastructure and its weaknesses
carriers.verdict: Fine as part of an independent agent's quote spread; rarely the standout.

carriers.name: The Hartford
carriers.strengths: Excellent for 50+ drivers via AARP, lifetime renewability features, good claims scores for its niche
carriers.weaknesses: Less competitive outside the AARP demographic
carriers.verdict: If you're 50+, the AARP program deserves a quote.

carriers.name: Mercury
carriers.strengths: Competitive California rates
carriers.weaknesses: Mixed claims reputation, regional only
carriers.verdict: A price play in California; pair with realistic service expectations.

carriers.name: Auto Club / AAA
carriers.strengths: Member pricing, regional clubs often have good service
carriers.weaknesses: Quality varies significantly between regional clubs — they are separate companies
carriers.verdict: Which AAA club underwrites you matters more than the AAA brand. Check your specific club's record.

carriers.name: Kemper
carriers.strengths: Writes higher-risk drivers others decline
carriers.weaknesses: High complaint ratios, weak claims satisfaction
carriers.verdict: A bridge carrier while your record improves — set a calendar reminder to requote in 12 months.

carriers.name: National General (Allstate)
carriers.strengths: Flexible underwriting for tough-to-place risks
carriers.weaknesses: High complaint volume, below-average claims experience
carriers.verdict: Same advice as Kemper: useful temporarily, requote when your situation improves.

carriers.name: Root
carriers.am_best: Not rated by AM Best (check Demotech)
carriers.strengths: Telematics-first pricing rewards genuinely good drivers
carriers.weaknesses: Thin track record, mixed claims reviews, financial strength less established
carriers.verdict: Interesting for excellent drivers comfortable with app-based everything; not for complex households.

carriers.name: Lemonade
carriers.strengths: Excellent digital experience, fast small claims, transparent giveback model
carriers.weaknesses: Young company, larger/complex claims draw mixed reviews, limited coverage depth
carriers.verdict: Great for renters and simple policies; think twice for your largest asset.

carriers.name: Hippo
carriers.strengths: Modern coverage defaults (smart home, equipment breakdown)
carriers.weaknesses: Young claims operation, underwriter behind the policy varies
carriers.verdict: Read who actually underwrites your policy — Hippo is often the storefront, not the insurer.

carriers.name: Cincinnati Insurance
carriers.strengths: Excellent claims reputation, strong for mid-to-high-value homes
carriers.weaknesses: Agent-only, less name recognition
carriers.verdict: An independent-agent gem, particularly for nicer homes.

carriers.name: Westfield
carriers.strengths: Strong regional service reputation, good bundling
carriers.weaknesses: Limited footprint
carriers.verdict: Worth a quote through an independent agent in its territory.

carriers.name: Shelter Insurance
carriers.strengths: Good claims satisfaction in its region, stable pricing
carriers.weaknesses: Regional only
carriers.verdict: A solid regional choice in the central US.

carriers.name: Country Financial
carriers.strengths: Strong claims scores, advisor-based service model
carriers.weaknesses: Regional footprint
carriers.verdict: Consistently above average where available.

carriers.name: Tower Hill
carriers.am_best: Check current Demotech/AM Best — FL market volatile
carriers.strengths: Writes Florida homes when nationals won't
carriers.weaknesses: Florida market instability affects all regional carriers
carriers.verdict: In Florida, verify the carrier's current financial rating every single renewal — no exceptions.

carriers.name: Citizens Property (FL)
carriers.strengths: Available when no one else is
carriers.weaknesses: Assessment risk, depopulation pressure, coverage restrictions
carriers.verdict: A safety net, not a destination. Work with an agent to move to the private market when possible.
